criteria.description: A backup dashboard summarizes fleet posture with counts, health, pending restore approvals, recent runs, and runtime observation data.
Operators can list and inspect backup repositories, policies, recipes, definitions, runs, verifications, restores, and retention runs.

The UI exposes required operator fields: repository backend kind and health, recipe target, policy verification/retention governance, restore eligibility, pending approvals, evidence, and terminal reasons.
Restore approvals and repository probes are issued as Nostr control-plane commands with d-tag idempotency keys and backup-specific result kinds.
The production web build succeeds with the backup section included in routing and navigation.
